description:
Packed KDA prefill from stored BF16 Q/K/V and raw gate/beta: QK L2 normalization, channel-wise safe decay with lower_bound=-5, beta sigmoid and recurrence. Produces BF16 output, in-place BF16 final state and optional periodic checkpoints. D=128; beta may be contiguous or row-strided with unit head stride, total tokens exceed one, and individual sequences may have length one. Projection, convolution and output RMSNorm are outside this boundary; unsupported native layouts remain recorded. 当前附带原生 solution 子域：固定 CuTe prefill 接口要求连续 beta；本题 row-strided beta 配置仍保留，当前 solution 不支持。 题目支持域允许更宽。

Production entry: flashinfer.kda.recurrent_kda; fixed source revision d849eca46875d3561fa48f6093936304580a1698.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Positive ragged prefill lengths with 2..16384 total tokens and at most 32 requests. State is [requests,heads,128,128]; checkpoint cadence and caller-owned output options remain explicit. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: State matrices retain [Hv,128,128] and production strides, offsets and shared backing. Normal carried states now come from 32 previous valid tokens with fixed layer A_log/bias and the declared GDN per-head or KDA per-channel decay recurrence, FP32 between stores and actual state dtype at checkpoints. Synthetic raw projections have channel/head gains and AR(1) coefficient .5. Conv history and the current request are contiguous windows of that same process; candidate checkpoint j and convolution accepted-prefix shift refer to the same past endpoint. This is generated history, not captured model data. Existing tiny/zero/saturation/cancellation cases retain their stress construction. Pool capacity and physical slot pattern are independent input parameters, not inferred from request count or candidate width. Slot0/null semantics and unused storage guards remain.

outputs_and_state.name: initial_state
outputs_and_state.kind: read/write; returned final_state shares exact logical storage view, Python object identity not required

validation.correctness_scope: Original library, validation_scope=sampled, SM103; fixed shape IDs 0-9, at most 2 recorded seeds per shape. 支持子域通过. Counts={'native_unsupported': 2, 'passed': 16}. No prior patched results inherited. Shared-GPU timings are execution checks only.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
